en: A vintage Romanian postcard. The front shows a sepia photo of a large rest-house building with arched windows and a central entrance, set among trees with people sitting in the garden—captioned for Sinaia. The reverse has printed Romanian headings, a blue handwritten message and address, a 40 bani stamp reading "R.P. ROMINA POSTA," and postmarks including "BUCURESTI 70."
